assessment.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional within observed scope. Subjective holistic scores, not averages of outcome stats and not physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMobile: Both fresh runs supported complete objective progression with clear guidance, atmospheric presentation and explicit results. Unsuccessful moving-target taps, crowded combat overlays and limited manual control coverage constrain confidence. Wins alone are not the grade.
reasons.controls: Large anchored touch controls and contextual hold action were usable; simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag and a strafe responded visibly. Multiple moving/flank target taps plus FIRE returned COVER without confirmed intended hit. Short synthetic samples do not establish sustained thumb comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Observed loop of three recoveries, timed vulnerable coils and defended deck upload gives distinct goals and pressure. Shield damage made ignoring threats consequential. Route assistance carried most traversal, leaving manual navigation and deeper combat variety unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive rain, teal industrial architecture, wet-looking ground, weapon effects and clean result card supported the observed atmosphere. Audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Map route, contextual ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER labels, automatic reload, target feedback, coil percentages and upload bar made completion understandable. Threat warnings competed with scene and controls.
reasons.readability: Core health/ammo/objective and results were readable at 844x390. Smaller environmental labels and packed right-side warnings were less comfortable; muted geometry reduced target separation in some views.
